summary: Configured a persistent, mutually TLS-authenticated three-member etcd 3.5.21 cluster on node1-node3, with node4 prepared as a gated replacement and recovery host.
actions_performed: Enabled etcd on node1-node3 with persistent data and firewall ports.
Generated and installed cluster, peer, server, and admin TLS credentials.
Provided administrative etcdctl access on node1 and node4.
Created and validated the current node4 snapshot at /var/backups/etcd/snapshot.db.
Installed periodic snapshot maintenance and node1/node2/node4 snapshot-recovery assets.
Verified cluster health, mTLS enforcement, reboot-persistent service configuration, and recovery bootstrap parameters.
